media.description: When Professor Oak makes a surprise appearance in Hoenn, bringing along Bulbasaur, Charmander, and Squirtle, Ash joins forces with them to battle Team Rocket.

media.title: The Bicker the Better
media.description: When another pair of Trainers challenge Ash and May to a Tag Battle, a falling-out between the two friends causes them to lose—but they soon resolve their differences.

media.title: Grass Hysteria!
media.description: When May accidentally enters a forbidden spot where only Grass-type Pokémon live, she quickly befriends a Bulbasaur.

media.title: Hokey Pokéballs
media.description: In an attempt to help May train her new Bulbasaur, Ash asks Professor Oak to send his own Bulbasaur to him, but someone diverts the transport…

media.title: Whiscash and Ash
media.description: When a famed Whiscash swallows Ash's Gym badges, he teams up with a fisherman to try to reel it in!

media.title: Me, Myself and Time
media.description: Ash and Pikachu meet up with an aspiring archaeologist who leads them to an ancient and mystical site.

media.title: A Fan with a Plan
media.description: May prepares to enter a prestigious contest, open only to Coordinators who have already won a ribbon! Her rival Drew seems to be the favorite with his powerful Masquerain.

media.title: Cruisin’ for a Losin’
media.description: May decides to use Bulbasaur in the Rubello Town Contest. Will its lack of experience cost her a ribbon?

media.title: Pearls are a Spoink’s Best Friend
media.description: When a Spoink loses the pearl on its head, Ash and friends volunteer to help search for it.

media.title: That’s Just Swellow
media.description: Ash, May, and James participate in the Pokéringer Competition, a curious sporting event in which Trainers direct their flying Pokémon in a race to collect rings dangling from floating balloons.

media.title: Take This House and Shuppet
media.description: Fights arise both between May and Max and among Team Rocket, as a Shuppet—a Pokémon that feeds on human anger—stirs them to conflict.

media.title: A Shroomish Skirmish
media.description: Team Rocket infuriates a group of Breloom, forcing Ash and friends to flee from their wrath.

media.title: Unfair Weather Friends
media.description: Ash and friends learn of the Legendary Pokémon Groudon and Kyogre when Team Magma is joined by a master of disguise.

media.title: Who’s Flying Now?
media.description: Ash and friends meet up with Fortree Gym Leader Winona at the Feather Carnival.

media.title: Sky High Gym Battle!
media.description: It's Swellow versus Swellow as Ash and Winona battle it out in the Fortree City Gym!

media.title: Lights, Camerupt, Action!
media.description: A movie fan travels from town to town, showing films to people who wouldn't otherwise have the chance to witness the cinema.

media.title: Crazy as a Lunatone
media.description: A group of conspiracy theorists known as the Pokémon Mystery Club pursues a Lunatone suspected to be behind a recent series of strange events.

media.title: The Garden of Eatin’
media.description: A troubled Snorlax wanders into a public park, creating no end of trouble.

media.title: A Scare to Remember
media.description: A fierce bout of amnesia causes Pikachu to join forces with Team Rocket!

media.title: Pokéblock, Stock and Berry
media.description: Before taking part in the Lilycove Pokémon Contest, May has time to study the art of Pokéblock preparation with a local master.

media.title: Lessons in Lilycove
media.description: The Lilycove Pokémon Contest is under way, but things are not looking good for May—her Combusken’s Fire Spin has spiraled out of control!

media.title: Judgment Day!
media.description: Trying to get to Mossdeep City for Ash's next Gym battle, our heroes are forced to take a detour.

title: Pokémon: Advanced Battle
description: Ash earns his final two Badges and secures himself a spot in the Hoenn League Championships, while May comes dangerously close to not getting her final Ribbon—setting the stage for epic showdowns with both of her rivals in the Grand Festival. Ash meets two Trainers that become his own Hoenn rivals, facing off against both of them during the course of the tournament. Upon returning to Kanto and reuniting with old friends, Ash is recruited for a new challenge—the Battle Frontier!

media.title: Clamperl of Wisdom
media.description: Our heroes reconnect with an unlucky Spoink, and it's still having trouble holding onto its pearl!

media.title: The Relicanth Really Can
media.description: Ash and friends join a treasure hunter to explore the deep sea, but Team Rocket is right behind them!

media.title: The Evolutionary War
media.description: When a Gorebyss-versus-Huntail rivalry develops between two islands, our heroes must get to the bottom of it!

media.title: Training Wrecks
media.description: The residents of Muscle Island are dedicated to physical fitness—but can they keep up with Ash in a Pokémon battle?

media.title: Gaining Groudon
media.description: After a rescue at sea, our heroes find themselves aboard Team Magma's submarine and learn more about the group's plan for world domination!

media.title: The Scuffle of Legends
media.description: Team Aqua and Team Magma have awakened the ancient Legendary Pokémon Groudon and Kyogre! Can Ash and friends escape?

media.title: It's Still Rocket Roll To Me
media.description: A Team Rocket strike on Mossdeep City drags our heroes—plus the city's twin Gym Leaders—into a space-shuttle scheme!

media.title: Solid As A Solrock
media.description: Ash takes on the Mossdeep Gym, going up against two Gym Leaders at once!

media.title: Vanity Affair
media.description: After winning his seventh Gym badge, Ash can't stop bragging about his battle skills…until he runs into a member of the Elite Four!

media.title: Where's Armaldo?
media.description: In an island nature preserve, Ash and friends come face to face with several Pokémon thought to be extinct!

media.title: A Cacturne For The Worse
media.description: May competes in a Pokémon Contest, where another Coordinator tries to sabotage her performance!

media.title: Claydol Big And Tall
media.description: When our heroes discover an enormous Poké Ball on an island, Team Rocket's meddling unleashes an ancient destructive force!

media.title: Once In A Mawile
media.description: Ash and friends meet a talented Trainer who performs a ribbon dance with her Mawile…until Team Rocket gets in the way!

media.title: Beg, Burrow and Steal
media.description: To help a local researcher, our heroes explore a massive underground labyrinth created by a group of Trapinch…and get into some trouble along the way!

media.title: Absol-Ute Disaster
media.description: An Absol appears to warn a village of danger, but the villagers think it's the one causing the trouble! Can our heroes clear up this misunderstanding?

media.title: Let It Snow, Let It Snow, Let It Snorunt
media.description: When a mischievous Snorunt steals Ash's hard-earned Gym badges, Ash chases after it—right into a raging snowstorm!

media.title: Do I Hear A Ralts?
media.description: Max finds an injured Ralts and tries to get it to a Pokémon Center, but its friends Gardevoir and Kirlia think our heroes are trying to steal it!

media.title: The Great Eight Fate!
media.description: Ash gets ready for his final Gym battle in the Hoenn region: a Double Battle against Gym Leader Juan, who used to be a Pokémon Coordinator!

media.title: Eight Ain't Enough
media.description: Ash and Juan battle it out in the Sootopolis Gym! Can Ash win his eighth Gym badge to qualify for the Hoenn League?

media.title: Showdown At Linoone!
media.description: When May discovers that two of her Poké Balls are missing, she naturally assumes it's Team Rocket! But the culprit could be someone else entirely…

media.title: Who, What, When, Where, Wynaut?
media.description: When Team Rocket interrupts a practice battle between May and her rival Drew, our heroes and their Pokémon have to sort out a big mix-up!

media.title: Date Expectations
media.description: Our heroes are delayed by a herd of Donphan on their way to Pacifidlog Town! Can May make it onto the ferry in time for her final Pokémon Contest?

media.title: Mean With Envy
media.description: May enters the Pacifidlog Contest, where she goes up against rivals Joshua and Erica, plus a mysterious competitor known only as "The Jester"…

media.title: Pacifidlog Jam
media.description: May competes against an unusual Meowth in the second round of the Pacifidlog Contest. Can she win the last ribbon she needs to qualify for the Grand Festival?

media.title: Berry, Berry Interesting
media.description: When our heroes stumble upon a wonderful berry harvest, May takes the opportunity to make some Pokéblocks for the Grand Festival, drawing the attention of a hungry Munchlax!

media.title: Less Is Morrison
media.description: Ash meets Morrison, another Trainer who's on his way to compete in the Hoenn League, and the two immediately become fierce rivals!

media.title: The Ribbon Cup Caper!
media.description: Aboard a luxury liner bound for Slateport City and the Grand Festival, our heroes must help Officer Jenny catch a master thief!

media.title: Hi Ho Silver Wind!
media.description: On the first day of the Grand Festival, May runs into her deceitful rival Harley once more!

media.title: Deceit And Assist
media.description: Ash meets a Coordinator whose ribbons have been stolen, and May listens to some bad advice before her first performance in the Grand Festival!

media.title: Rhapsody In Drew
media.description: May is up against Harley in the second round of the Grand Festival! Can she triumph over his treacherous tactics?

media.title: Island Time
media.description: When our heroes win free tickets to Ever Grande City for the Hoenn League Championships, they're delighted—until it becomes clear this is another of Team Rocket's schemes!

media.title: Like A Meowth To A Flame
media.description: While training for the Hoenn League, Ash meets fellow Trainer Tyson and his Meowth in boots, and they discover that the ceremonial torch has been stolen!

media.title: Saved By The Beldum
media.description: Ash, Morrison, and Tyson register for the Hoenn League, and it appears that Tyson's Meowth has an unfortunate past…

media.title: From Brags To Riches
media.description: In the qualifying rounds, Ash faces a serious challenge: he has to win three matches in a row, and each match is a Double Battle!

media.title: Shocks and Bonds
media.description: Ash has made it through the qualifying rounds, but now he faces an impressive Trainer named Katie in a full battle, where both of them will use all six of their Pokémon!

media.title: A Judgment Brawl
media.description: Ash has fallen behind in his full battle against Katie! Can he recover and make it to the second round?

media.title: Choose It Or Lose It!
media.description: Ash faces his friend and rival Morrison in the second round of the Hoenn League!

media.title: At The End Of The Fray
media.description: Ash goes up against his rival Tyson in the quarterfinals of the Hoenn League!

media.title: The Scheme Team
media.description: The Hoenn League is over, and it's time for Ash to bid farewell to his traveling companions and head home—but he can't resist one more challenge from a Gym Leader along the way!

media.title: The Right Place And The Right Mime
media.description: Max and May come to visit Ash in Pallet Town, along with Misty and Brock, and they all make plans for another journey together—this time, to the Battle Frontier!

media.title: A Real Cleffa-Hanger
media.description: Our heroes stop for a picnic at the base of Mt. Moon, where they encounter the rarely seen Cleffa, Clefairy, and Clefable!

media.title: Numero Uno Articuno
media.description: On the way to Ash's first match at the Battle Frontier, our heroes see the Legendary Pokémon Articuno flying through a snowstorm!

media.title: The Symbol Life
media.description: Ash calls in his old friend Charizard to help in his battle against Frontier Brain Noland and his friend Articuno!

media.title: Hooked on Onix
media.description: Provoked by Team Rocket, hordes of Rock-type Pokémon attack our heroes on their way to the Battle Arena!

media.title: Rough, Tough Jigglypuff
media.description: Ash and friends fall into a trap set by a man who wants to catch a Jigglypuff for his daughter's birthday!

media.title: On Cloud Arcanine
media.description: May and her rival Drew go after the same Arcanine, both hoping to catch it for their next Contest!

media.title: Sitting Psyduck
media.description: Ash and friends rescue a sad Psyduck from a group of Fighting types, but they can't figure out how to cheer it up…

media.title: Hail To The Chef!
media.description: Our heroes and Team Rocket check out a new restaurant owned by two sisters who can't stop squabbling!

media.title: Caterpie's Big Dilemma
media.description: After a scientific experiment goes awry, Ash and friends try to track down a Caterpie that has grown to enormous proportions!

media.title: The Saffron Con
media.description: Our heroes are in Saffron City for May's first Pokémon Contest in the Kanto region—and her shady rival Harley is competing, too!

media.title: The Hurdle For Squirtle
media.description: The Saffron Pokémon Contest is under way! Can May win her first ribbon in the Kanto region?

media.title: Pasta La Vista!
media.description: Ash checks out the Fighting Dojo in Saffron City and ends up getting recruited as a new student!

title: Pokémon: Battle Frontier
description: The territory might be familiar, but even Ash and Brock can find more than a few surprises in their home region of Kanto, like a Pokémon Ranger hot on the cases of two Legendary Pokémon! May’s back on the Contest path, blazing a trail to the Kanto Grand Festival, while Ash seeks out the hidden facilities of the Battle Frontier. If finding them wasn’t hard enough, he’s still got battles with the Frontier Brains to deal with—much tougher than any Gym Leader he’s ever faced.

media.title: Fear Factor Phony!
media.description: Ash and friends wander into a ghost town, where they try to help settle a dispute between a group of Ghost-type Pokémon and a group of Psychic-type Pokémon.

media.title: Sweet Baby James!
media.description: When May’s Munchlax gets sick, Ash and friends seek the help of a kindly couple who specialize in healing Pokémon…and who just happen to be James’s Nanny and Pop-Pop!

media.title: A Chip off the Old Brock!
media.description: After Brock’s Mudkip evolves into a Marshtomp and causes some trouble, Ash and friends befriend an elderly medicine-maker and help her assistants fight off Team Rocket’s thieving advances.

media.title: Wheel…Of…Frontier!
media.description: At the Battle Arena, Ash battles Frontier Brain Greta for his second Frontier Symbol!

media.title: May’s Egg-cellent Adventure!
media.description: May helps the daughter of a family of Pokémon Egg ranchers start her own Pokémon Contest journey, and receives her own Pokémon Egg as a thank-you gift.

media.title: Weekend Warrior!
media.description: May competes against a former rock’n’roll guitarist and band leader in the Silver Town Pokémon Contest for her second Kanto ribbon!

media.title: On Olden Pond!
media.description: Taking a break from Ash’s training regimen to do a little fishing, our heroes help a young woman keep the ownership of her family’s lake from a land developer.

media.title: Tactics Theatrics!
media.description: At the Battle Dome, Ash challenges Frontier Brain Tucker, a master of both battle tactics and showbiz savvy, for his third Frontier Symbol.

media.title: Reversing the Charges!
media.description: On their way to the Battle Pike, Ash and friends meet a supercharged Elekid who’s on a rampage, attacking everything in sight—including Max!

media.title: The Green Guardian!
media.description: The Mythical Pokémon Celebi has been injured in the forest, and Ash and friends, along with a Pokémon Ranger, nurse Celebi back to health.

media.title: From Cradle to Save!
media.description: On their way to the Battle Pike, our heroes come across a Pokémon ninja school, where they help the students rescue their Pokémon from Team Rocket’s clutches.

media.title: Time-Warp Heals All Wounds!
media.description: At an abandoned train station, May meets a woman who lost the love of her life thanks to a sad twist of fate.

media.title: Queen of the Serpentine!
media.description: At the Battle Pike, Ash must further hone his on-the-spot strategy skills to defeat a soft-spoken, fierce Frontier Brain named Queen Lucy and win his fourth Frontier Symbol.

media.title: Off the Unbeaten Path!
media.description: After arriving on Potpourri Island, our heroes discover the Pokémon Orienteering competition just about to take place and decide to enter, vying for the coveted Pokémon Teamwork medal!

media.title: Harley Rides Again!
media.description: In the Wisteria Town Pokémon Contest, May discovers she is to compete against her old rival Harley.

media.title: Odd Pokémon Out!
media.description: As our heroes continue toward May’s next Pokémon Contest, Ash’s Grovyle finds itself nursing a crush on Nurse Joy’s Meganium!

media.title: Spontaneous Combusken
media.description: After meeting a new Coordinator named Brianna who’s a fan of hers and an even bigger fan of Drew’s, May discovers she must battle her in order to win her third Pokémon Contest ribbon.

media.title: Cutting the Ties that Bind!
media.description: After a frustrated Sceptile runs off into the forest, Ash and Pikachu go after it and run into a swarm of angry Beedrill—and the next Frontier Brain!

media.title: Ka Boom with a View!
media.description: It’s time for Ash’s next Battle Frontier challenge: a battle in the impressive outdoor arena at the Battle Palace, against Frontier Brain Spenser!

media.title: King and Queen for a Day!
media.description: On their way to Ash’s next Battle Frontier challenge, our heroes come across a couple of Pokémon TV stars who aren’t feeling well, so Brock’s Bonsly and James’s Mime Jr. act as stand-ins!

media.title: Curbing the Crimson Tide!
media.description: After hearing stories about many Trainers and Pokémon being defeated and taunted by a mysterious talking Pokémon known as Red Lightning, our heroes decide to find out what’s really going on.

media.title: What I Did for Love!
media.description: When Brock meets up with a lovely Pokémon breeder who used to be a Coordinator, she talks him into competing against May in the Gardenia Pokémon Contest!

media.title: Three Jynx and a Baby!
media.description: On their way to the Battle Tower for Ash’s next challenge, our heroes come across a cute little Smoochum who is fiercely guarded by three Jynx, and Ash has to convince them he’s on their side!

media.title: Talking a Good Game!
media.description: On their way to the Battle Tower, our heroes meet an amazing person who seems to be able to communicate with Pokémon by sensing their feelings…and more surprises await!

media.title: Second Time’s the Charm!
media.description: After losing to Frontier Brain Anabel, Ash buckles down for some unusual special training—and Anabel joins him! Can he defeat her in the rematch?

media.title: Pokémon Ranger–Deoxys’ Crisis (Part 1)
media.description: After witnessing strange behavior from several kinds of Pokémon on their way to Pewter City, our heroes and Pokémon Ranger Solana encounter an electromagnetic disturbance, which leads them to the discovery of a troubled Deoxys!

media.title: Pokémon Ranger–Deoxys’ Crisis (Part 2)
media.description: After Deoxys flies away with Max and Meowth, our heroes set out to rescue them and discover what’s wrong with the Mythical Pokémon!

media.title: All that Glitters Is not Golden!
media.description: On their way to Ash’s final Frontier Battle and Brock’s hometown of Pewter City, our heroes discover a wandering golden Sudowoodo and the estranged Trainer who caused its unusual coloring.

media.title: New Plot – Odd Lot!
media.description: May is going after her fifth Contest Ribbon to qualify for the Grand Festival, but when her shady rival Harley teams up with Team Rocket, things don’t look good!

media.title: Going for Choke!
media.description: After a shaky start in the Mulberry Pokémon Contest, May makes it through to the finals, where she goes up against “Jessebella”—Team Rocket’s Jessie in disguise!

media.title: The Ole’ Berate and Switch!
media.description: After a squabble causes Jessie and James to part ways, they team up with fellow Team Rocket agents Butch and Cassidy for a Poké Ball-swiping scheme!

media.title: Grating Spaces!
media.description: Upon arriving in Pewter City, our heroes learn that Brock’s old Gym is being remodeled by none other than Team Rocket in disguise, and Brock and Ash must battle them to put a stop to it!

media.title: Battling the Enemy Within
media.description: In the ancient ruins beneath the Battle Pyramid, Ash is mysteriously possessed by the spirit of an ancient and evil king, who challenges Frontier Brain Brandon to a battle for all of his Pokémon.

media.title: Slaking Kong!
media.description: On their way to the Grand Festival, our heroes help a berry farmer reclaim his stolen crop.

media.title: May, We Harley Drew’d Ya!
media.description: As the Grand Festival gets under way at the Indigo Plateau, May has her hands full trying to compete with the best Coordinators in the world, including Harley, Drew, and new friend Solidad!

media.title: Thinning the Hoard!
media.description: The Grand Festival is going strong as May faces down one impressive competitor after another!

media.title: Channeling the Battle Zone!
media.description: May faces Drew in the quarterfinals of the Grand Festival, and the two seem to be very evenly matched! Can May come out ahead?

media.title: Aipom and Circumstance!
media.description: On their way to Ash’s rematch with Brandon at the Battle Pyramid in Fennel Valley, our heroes come across a village taking part in the annual ritual of choosing a king, and Ash’s Aipom becomes a most unwilling candidate!

media.title: Strategy Tomorrow – Comedy Tonight!
media.description: Our heroes meet an aspiring comedian named Audrey and her showbiz sidekick and Pokémon partner, Chatot.

media.title: Duels of the Jungle!
media.description: Our heroes find themselves embroiled in Pokémon politics as two Weavile face off for leadership of a group of Sneasel!

media.title: Overjoyed!
media.description: When our heroes arrive at the Battle Pyramid for Ash’s battle with Brandon, they discover a Nurse Joy who’s a big fan of Ash and May!

media.title: The Unbeatable Lightness of Seeing!
media.description: After their recent defeats in important matches at the Battle Pyramid and the Grand Festival, Ash and May are feeling a little down, until several old friends come together to support them.

media.title: Pinch Healing!
media.description: When Nurse Joy becomes too ill to take care of the Pokémon Center, our heroes pitch in, coming to the aid of a Pokésitter and his charges after a bus accident.

media.title: Gathering the Gang of Four!
media.description: Ash prepares for his final rematch with Brandon at the Battle Pyramid by rounding up the Pokémon he’s been with the longest, spending his time sharing old memories with them and training intensely.

media.title: Pace – The Final Frontier!
media.description: Ash has lost to Brandon in two previous battles, and now his Charizard has been defeated! Can he battle back to claim the final Frontier Symbol?

media.title: Once More with Reeling!
media.description: Ash has beaten the Battle Frontier, but his competitive spirit won’t let him rest for long, and he and May both sign up for an unofficial Pokémon Contest in Terracotta Town!

media.title: Home Is Where the Start Is!
media.description: After one last contest battle between Ash and May, our heroes go their separate ways, and Ash discovers his next adventure!

title: Now Playing: Pokémon: Diamond & Pearl
description: If Gary Oak is headed for the Sinnoh region, then Ash Ketchum won’t be far behind! Ready to take on the Sinnoh League, Ash brings along Pikachu and meets up with Brock in Sinnoh, where the pair of Trainers are soon joined by a third—Dawn, a novice Pokémon Coordinator determined to follow in the footsteps of her mother. Both Ash and Dawn struggle with their respective paths, but it’s easy for them to make new friends, gaining new Pokémon like Turtwig and Piplup.

media.title: Following A Maiden’s Voyage!
media.description: While Ash, Pikachu, and Aipom head toward the Sinnoh region, where lots of new adventures await them, a young Trainer named Dawn is just beginning her own Pokémon journey.

media.title: Two Degrees Of Separation!
media.description: As Dawn sets off to find an injured Pikachu’s Trainer, Ash hears the story from Professor Rowan and sets off to find Dawn—and reunites with Brock along the way!

media.title: When Pokémon Worlds Collide!
media.description: As Ash and Brock finally meet up with Dawn and are reunited with Pikachu, a Trainer named Paul challenges Ash to a battle.

media.title: Dawn Of A New Era!
media.description: Dawn has her very first battle with Nando, a Pokémon bard who's torn between two possible paths on his journey.

media.title: Gettin' Twiggy With It!
media.description: After Team Rocket makes off with Ash’s Pikachu once again, a feisty Turtwig appears to rescue Pikachu and later takes a bit of time to warm up to our heroes.

media.title: Different Strokes For Different Blokes!
media.description: After showing up again seemingly out of nowhere, Paul is pitted against Ash in a series of battles that reflect just how different they are as Trainers and people.

media.title: Like It Or Lup It!
media.description: On their way to Jubilife City and Dawn’s first Pokémon Contest, Piplup decides to help a group of Pokémon in need.
